title: Technical Sales Leader - Single Use Solutions
jobDescription: Role level : Senior technical sales / applications leadership; 15+ years experience. Primary focus : Customer solution development, technical positioning, application support, and team leadership. Industry coverage: Biopharma, biotech, vaccines, biologicals, CDMOs, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical manufacturing. The role of an Applications / Technical Sales Manager is pivotal in creating impactful solutions for our customers. With deep process knowledge, technical expertise, and commercial acumen, the individual will lead a team of Application Specialists and deliver innovative solutions that address the unique application needs of clients across biopharmaceutical, vaccine, biological, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical manufacturing environments. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences such as Biology, Molecular Biology, Microbiology, Immunology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Biopharmaceutical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or related disciplines. 15+ years of industry experience in Biopharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, Vaccines, Biologicals, and/or Sterile Pharmaceutical Manufacturing. Strong knowledge across bioprocessing and pharmaceutical manufacturing workflows, including upstream processing, downstream processing, formulation, buffer/media preparation, sterile manufacturing, and fill-finish operations. Strong understanding of customer manufacturing processes, technical challenges, material requirements, and evolving industry expectations. Regulatory & Compliance Knowledge. Strong understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements applicable to single-use technologies used in biopharmaceutical and pharmaceutical manufacturing. Awareness of BPOG Single-Use guidance and USP / ISO standards relevant to single-use systems, fluid contact materials, sterilization, biocompatibility, and particulate control. Customer-focused, solution-oriented, and able to convert technical insight into meaningful business impact. Strong leadership, communication, influencing, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Possess deep understanding of bioprocessing workflows and/or sterile pharmaceutical manufacturing operations. Strong understanding of customer technical challenges, process requirements, material requirements, and regulatory expectations. Capable of engaging effectively with stakeholders across Process Development, Manufacturing, Engineering, Validation, Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, and Procurement. Demonstrated project management and execution skills, with the ability to manage and prioritize multiple technical engagements and strategic opportunities. Able to develop and maintain strong technical relationships with targeted key accounts. Possess strong knowledge of regulatory expectations associated with single-use assemblies, fluid handling systems, and critical process components used in regulated manufacturing environments. Play a key role in identifying, qualifying, and prioritizing project opportunities, ensuring effective support for both internal and external customers. Contribute to the technical positioning of AFH products within customer manufacturing processes and influence strategic decision-making. Improve the quality, competitiveness, and value proposition of AFH products and service offerings. Gather, compile, and analyze Voice of Customer (VOC) insights to identify unmet needs and create differentiated solutions. Develop a deep understanding of the competitive landscape and emerging market trends to guide future product and service development. Stay current with industry, technology, and regulatory developments and communicate insights across the organization. Support local and global sales processes, strategic account management initiatives, and business growth objectives. Build and maintain strong technical relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers within strategic customer accounts. Provide technical and regulatory guidance regarding implementation, qualification, validation, and lifecycle management of single-use systems. Support customer discussions related to supplier qualification, extractables and leachables assessments, contamination control strategies, particulate risk management, sterilization validation, and change management processes. Collaborate with Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Product Management, Operations, and R&D teams to ensure AFH solutions align with current and evolving regulations and standards. Participate in customer audits, technical reviews, product evaluations, and qualification activities as required. Support both biopharmaceutical and sterile pharmaceutical manufacturing customers in achieving compliance, operational excellence, and process optimization. Preferred Industry Experience. Candidates with experience supporting leading biopharmaceutical, vaccine, CDMO, biologics, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical manufacturers supplying regulated markets such as US FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, and other ICH-regulated regions will be highly preferred. Biopharma / Biotech Applications. Monoclonal antibodies (m Abs). Cell & gene therapies. CDMO biologics manufacturing. US & EU regulated-market supply. The ideal candidate combines deep bioprocessing and pharmaceutical manufacturing expertise, strong understanding of single-use technologies, knowledge of regulatory and quality requirements for regulated markets, proven technical sales and key account management experience, leadership capability to build high-performing technical teams, and the ability to translate customer needs into commercially successful solutions. Education. Experience.

title: Pricing Analyst
jobDescription:
As a key member of the Commercial Excellence Team, reporting directly to the AMEA Pricing Manager, the Pricing Analyst will play a critical role in supporting Avantor’s pricing strategy. This role focuses on developing and implementing data-driven pricing strategies aimed at optimizing revenue, maximizing margins, and enhancing market share, while ensuring high customer satisfaction. The Pricing Analyst will work closely with Sales, Portfolio Management, Master Data, and Finance teams to streamline pricing operations, ensuring efficient collaboration and process optimization. You will partner with analytics leadership to drive improvements in pricing infrastructure, ensuring pricing decisions are well-informed and based on high-quality data. This role also involves generating insightful data analysis reports and making actionable recommendations to support key business decisions. The position spans multiple business units, covering the analytical needs of both the Laboratory Solutions Segment (LSS) and the Bioscience Production Segment (BPS).

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree from a Tier-1 college; an MBA from a Tier-1 or Tier-2 business school is preferred but not mandatory. Experience: Minimum of 3 years of experience as a Pricing Analyst or in a similar role, ideally within an MNC in a B2B environment managing a diverse product portfolio. Strong understanding of pricing strategies, optimization techniques, and experience with margin analysis and price-volume-mix. Proficiency in SAP, advanced Excel, R programming language, and data visualization tools (Power BI / Tableau). Experience with pricing tools is an added advantage. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to perform complex analyses. Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining data accuracy. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while working under tight deadlines. Strong organizational skills with a proactive and self-driven work ethic. Business acumen along with excellent communication and presentation skills. Collaborate with Sales and Portfolio teams to coordinate pricing proposals and opportunities. Continuously refine pricing processes by incorporating feedback from both internal and external stakeholders. Develop price guidance, metrics, and product cost analysis (for both self-manufactured and traded products), and perform gross margin analysis at local and corporate levels. Conduct detailed pricing analytics, including price elasticity studies, geographic/regional behavior analysis, discount trends, price bell curve analysis, and price-volume-mix evaluation. Leverage advanced analytics to simulate pricing scenarios and assess impacts on profitability and market competitiveness. Drive continuous improvement in pricing processes, ensuring efficient and effective execution. Coordinate with AMEA Global Master Data and Global Pricing Operations to resolve costing and pricing issues within the ERP system. Maintain and monitor the pricing repository, identifying opportunities for system enhancements. Generate comprehensive data analysis reports and provide actionable insights to guide business decisions.

title: Assistant Manager - Planning and Procurement
jobDescription: Works independently under close supervision, plan, schedule and monitor the movement of material through the production cycle. Determine material requirements from engineering and production schedules. Coordinate the efficient movement of materials with purchasing, production and engineering. Develop specifications for new contract orders. Responsible for business system data input and integrity; creates and maintains bills of material and parts/commodities numbers in supply chain management or other enterprisewide systems. This role is responsible not only for coordination and execution but also for strategic planning, forecasting, and analysis to ensure the right product is available at the right place and time. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in high-frequency planning environments, covering raw materials, manufacturing, and distribution. Works independently under close supervision, planner creates short and long-term plan at item/location level of planned stock movements across the distribution network in order to meet customer service and operational targets. Provides accurate information to both business customers and support teams through the correct use of all information technology systems. Responsible for business system data and integrity. Displays flexibility and adaptability to work with and assist other teams within the organization. Graduate in engineering; MBA desirable. Minimum 5-8 years of experience specializing in Supply Chain, Supply and Demand Planning & Inventory Management. Strong analytical and quantitative skills. Excellent communication both verbal and written. Experience with APO or similar forecasting tools is highly desirable. APICS/CPIM certification desirable. Global Supply Chain experience a plus. Formal problem-solving training is desirable, i.e. Six Sigma. Ability to work in a fast-paced, multifaceted environment with a proactive approach. Able to work well under sustained pressure with conflicting priorities, optimizing resources and responding to fast changing circumstances. Apply analytical and statistical techniques to develop a tactical demand forecast and replenishment plan supporting key product lines and/or customer segments. Support monthly Sales and Operations Planning process efforts. Determine optimal inventory position for each SKU/ stocking location. Analyze data and make recommendations on increasing/decreasing inventory targets; establish ideal safety stock targets. Proactively adjust forecast and replenishment strategies to optimize inventory investment. Leverage ERP systems to manage planning data, generate reports, and support decision-making. Continuously improving planning processes and tools to enhance supply chain responsiveness and agility. Develop purchasing plans, inventory forecasts, and financial projections to support business objectives and operational requirements. Negotiate changes with suppliers as needed. Supervise and improve KPIs such as forecast accuracy, inventory health, service, OTIF, backorder reduction for own portfolio. Perform variance analysis by comparing actual performance against budgeted and forecasted results, identifying key drivers and recommending corrective actions. Analyze the predicted impact of new supplier/product launches, product promotions, or discontinuations. Commit company resources to support new launches and initiatives. Collaborate with cross-functional collaborators including Procurement, Manufacturing, Sales, Logistics, and Finance to enhance forecast accuracy and inventory performance. Collaborate with Purchasing teams to ensure monthly, quarterly, and annual procurement and inventory targets are achieved. Work closely with Marketing and Product Development teams to forecast demand for both existing and new products. Support Team Leader with daily operational coordination during the day-to-day planning activities for the own portfolio. Share good practice and findings with the wider team to ensure consistency and standardization in processes. Display flexibility and adaptability to work with and assist other teams within the organization. Perform other duties as assigned.
